L1.en: Viśvāmitra had no doubt. With him there, Rāma would finish them.
L1.hi: विश्वामित्र को कोई शक नहीं था — वो साथ रहें तो राम उन दोनों को ख़त्म कर देंगे।
L1.te: విశ్వామిత్రుడికి ఏ సందేహం లేదు — ఆయన తోడు ఉంటే రాముడు ఆ ఇద్దరినీ చంపేస్తాడు.
L1.speaker: VISHVAMITRA
L1.speaker_rule: VISHVAMITRA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L2.en: He said: if Vasiṣṭha and the counsellors agreed, let Rāma go.
L2.hi: उन्होंने कहा — अगर वसिष्ठ और मंत्री मान जाएँ, तो राम को जाने दो।
L2.te: వసిష్ఠుడూ, మంత్రులూ ఒప్పుకుంటే రాముణ్ణి పంపించు, అన్నాడు.
L2.speaker: VISHVAMITRA
L2.evidence: CLM-0019, 18.16; Dutt XIX — the condition M6 pays off
L2.speaker_rule: VISHVAMITRA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L3.en: Ten nights. That was all he asked.
L3.hi: दस रातें। बस इतना ही माँगा था।

L4.en: Dasharatha... had only fear. Not of Rāma. For him.
L4.hi: दशरथ को... सिर्फ़ डर था। राम पर नहीं। राम के लिए।
L4.te: దశరథుడికి... భయం మాత్రమే. రాముడి మీద కాదు. రాముడి కోసం.
L4.evidence: the fear is SOURCE_FACT at 18.20 — CLM-0016 (Dutt: sorrow, apprehension); "not of Rāma, for him" is ours

L5.en: He said Rāma was not yet sixteen.
L5.hi: उन्होंने कहा — राम अभी सोलह के भी नहीं थे।
L5.te: రాముడికి ఇంకా పదహారు కూడా నిండలేదు, అన్నాడు.
L5.speaker: DASHARATHA
L5.speaker_rule: DASHARATHA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L6.en: The way his father saw it, he hadn't finished learning weapons.
L6.hi: पिता की नज़र में, अभी उसने हथियार पूरे सीखे भी नहीं थे।
L6.te: తండ్రి దృష్టిలో — ముక్కుపచ్చలారని పిల్లాడికి ఇంకా ఆయుధాలు పూర్తిగా రావు.
L6.speaker: DASHARATHA
L6.speaker_rule: DASHARATHA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L7.hi: राजा ने अपनी सेना देने को कहा।

L8.en: He said he'd go himself, bow in hand, while he lived.
L8.hi: कहा — मैं ख़ुद चलूँगा। धनुष लेकर। जब तक साँस है।
L8.te: నేనే వస్తాను అన్నాడు. విల్లు పట్టుకుని. ఊపిరి ఉన్నంతవరకు.
L8.speaker: DASHARATHA
L8.speaker_rule: DASHARATHA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L10.en: He said he couldn't live without Rāma. Not for a moment.
L10.hi: उन्होंने कहा — राम के बिना वो एक पल नहीं रह सकते।
L10.te: రాముడు లేకుండా ఒక్క క్షణం కూడా ఉండలేనని అన్నాడు.

screenplay.en: Viśvāmitra had no doubt. With him there, Rāma would finish them.
He said: if Vasiṣṭha and the counsellors agreed, let Rāma go.
Ten nights. That was all he asked.
Dasharatha... had only fear. Not of Rāma. For him.
He said Rāma was not yet sixteen.
The way his father saw it, he hadn't finished learning weapons.
He said he'd go himself, bow in hand, while he lived.
He said he couldn't live without Rāma. Not for a moment.

sound.design:
Room tone continued from the previous film — same file, same level, no reseat. Cloth and a
sandal on stone as the king rises. **One held low string enters at beat 11** and a second a
fifth above at beat 12; both fade across six seconds and are gone before the joined hands.
The last three beats are room tone only. The hold is a hard cut to true silence for 1.0 s,
then room tone 3 dB under, lamp steady. **No score on the refusal.**
sound.room_tone: continues across a continuous join; never reseated

hero_frame.why: A king with palms joined is read instantly by any Indian viewer, and the face is love, not weakness — which protects him from caricature in the frame that will be shared most.
hero_frame.use: poster, share card, and the frame a stranger sees first

continuity._what: What must not change between cuts.
standing_rules: The lamp stays where it is. Its flame moves; its position does not.
Daśaratha's ring is on the right hand in every hand detail, in every film.
The throne is occupied in films 1–2 and empty from film 3 onward. It is never re-occupied.
Viśvāmitra's staff is planted at his right through films 1–4. It moves once, in film 5.
The sage's cloth and seated posture do not change across four films — that stillness is the performance and a shifted fold breaks it.
Once the king steps down in film 3, he does not return to the dais in any later shot.

per_join.continuous: The frame is IDENTICAL across the join — same plate, same grade, same room tone. Not a similar frame: the same one.
per_join.hard: Location or time has changed. Room tone changes with it.

never: No new portrait of either man at a slightly different angle to manufacture variety.
No reverse playback, no push on a static plate to imply motion, no crop passed off as a cut.
**The reverse angle at beat 12 must be a real reverse** — the hall from his eyeline. If it
The sage never gestures, never leans forward, never narrows his eyes. Beat 18 is his only
No score on the offers. The chord enters at beat 11 and is gone by beat 19.
